summary: Rahu's 18-year mahadasha is described by the classical texts as an unsettling period of sudden rises and losses, foreign or unconventional contacts, trouble from authorities, hidden illness and family strain, unless Rahu is well placed (exalted, in a favourable sign, in an upachaya or good house, or joined with benefics or a yogakaraka), when it can give power, wealth, property and recognition, often through foreigners or the state. Gains made in it are repeatedly said to be unstable and liable to be lost toward the end.
common_outcomes: trouble or displeasure from rulers and officials, removal from office or loss of status (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21)
danger from thieves, poison, fire and weapons (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21)
mental unrest and anxiety (Phaladeepika 19.14; BPHS 47.40-43 when afflicted)
illness or trouble to spouse and children, loss of or separation from relatives (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21; BPHS 47.40-43; Jataka Parijata 18.96)
an obscure, hard-to-diagnose illness; eye and head complaints (Phaladeepika 19.21)
living or wandering in a foreign or distant place (Jataka Parijata 18.96)
when Rahu is well placed: wealth, property, vehicles and recognition through friends, the state or a foreign government (BPHS 47.34-39)
rare_outcomes: rise to near-royal affluence and wide fame when Rahu is with a benefic and outside the 6th, 8th and 12th (Phaladeepika 19.15)
command of an army, kingly status (Jataka Parijata 18.108, sign list corrupt in the scan)
insults from lowly people, scandal, leg injury, failure of undertakings (Phaladeepika 19.14)
imprisonment for fraud or political offences when Rahu is in Leo; miscarriage or loss of a child when Rahu is in Scorpio (B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV)
political rise, often after the fall of a mentor or leader, when Rahu is tied to the Amatyakaraka or the lagna lord (Sanjay Rath, srath.com)

by_area.personality: Restless, anxious or ill-natured moods are named (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21); irritability with Rahu in Gemini, mean tendencies in Aquarius (Raman). Frawley describes the period as dispersing energy and drawing attention toward what is foreign or distant.
by_area.career: Removal from office, failed undertakings and trouble from rulers are the default (Phaladeepika 19.14, 19.21). Well placed, Rahu gives comforts and wealth through government favour or a foreign government (BPHS 47.34-39), sudden promotion and state recognition in Capricorn, high position in Virgo (Raman). Loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 47.40-43).
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth at the start of an afflicted period (BPHS 47.40-43); wealth, crops and new house when exalted (BPHS 47.34-39); landholdings, vehicles and servants in Virgo, Pisces or Scorpio, liable to be lost at the end (Phaladeepika 19.16). Raman lists effortless gains in Sagittarius and sudden riches in Virgo, losses and litigation in Libra.
by_area.health: Obscure, hard-to-diagnose illness, poisoning, eye and head ailments (Phaladeepika 19.21); severe illness (Jataka Parijata 18.96); leg injury (Phaladeepika 19.14).
by_area.relationships: Trouble to spouse and children when Rahu is afflicted (BPHS 47.40-43); loss of or separation from wife and children (Phaladeepika 19.21; Jataka Parijata 18.96); disputes with friends (Phaladeepika 19.21). Domestic and marital happiness when Rahu is in Virgo or Aries (Raman).
by_area.family: Loss of relatives (Phaladeepika 19.14); illness to children (Phaladeepika 19.14); bereavement of parents at the end of the period (Jataka Parijata 18.109); sons and domestic happiness when well placed (BPHS 47.34-39).
by_area.spirituality: Religious inclination when Rahu is exalted (BPHS 47.34-39); pilgrimages and philosophical study with Rahu in Taurus, humanitarian service in Cancer, household recitation of sacred texts in Aries (Raman).

strengtheners: Rahu with or aspected by benefics, in a benefic's sign, in the 1st, 3rd, 4th, 7th, 10th or 11th (BPHS 47.34-39)
Rahu with a benefic and outside the 6th, 8th and 12th (Phaladeepika 19.15)

Rahu in a kendra or trikona and connected with a kendra or trikona lord becomes a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20.52); Santhanam's note to BPHS 47 says association with a yogakaraka makes Rahu very beneficial
Rahu in a sign owned by a benefic and connected with a planet gives good results in that planet's sub-periods (Phaladeepika 20.53)
Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th (Santhanam's note closing BPHS ch. 48)
a strong, well-placed lord of the sign Rahu occupies (Raman: the nodes give the results of the lords of the houses they occupy)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th: troubles throughout (BPHS 47.40-43)
Rahu with a malefic or with a maraka planet, or debilitated (Scorpio): loss of status and residence, mental agony, trouble to spouse and children (BPHS 47.40-43)
a benefic joined to Rahu can be spoiled and cause harm, especially near the end of its own period (Phaladeepika 20.39)
Rahu in Gemini, Leo, Libra, Scorpio or Aquarius (Raman's sign list)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges Rahu's dasha by Rahu's own sign, dignity, house from the lagna and associations. Santhanam's text gives Taurus as exaltation, Gemini as moolatrikona and Aquarius as own sign (noting others give Virgo). Phaladeepika 20.52-53 and Raman tie the results to the planets Rahu joins and to the lord of its sign, so the dispositor's house rulership for the lagna matters. No consulted source gives results by Rahu's house from the Moon.

source_views.source: BPHS ch. 47 (Effects of Dasas) vv. 34-43, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Exalted Rahu gives wealth, crops, vehicles through friends and the state, a new house, sons, religious leaning and recognition. With or aspected by benefics, in a benefic sign and in the 1st, 3rd, 4th, 7th, 10th or 11th: comforts by royal favour, wealth through a foreign ruler, domestic happiness. In the 8th or 12th: distress. With a malefic or maraka planet, or debilitated: loss of position and residence, mental agony, trouble to spouse and children, poor food; wealth lost at the start, some relief and gain in one's own country in the middle, anxiety at the end. Translator's note: association with a yogakaraka makes Rahu a yogakaraka.

source_views.source: BPHS ch. 47 vv. 3-6, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: A dasha lord in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd drekkana shows its results at the start, middle or end of the period, reversed for retrograde planets; the translator applies the reversal to the always-retrograde nodes. A dasha lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated or in an enemy sign at birth gives unfavourable results.

source_views.source: BPHS ch. 48, closing translator's note, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Rahu and Ketu give favourable results in the 3rd, 6th and 11th.

source_views.source: BPHS ch. 57 (Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Rahu), tr. G.C. Sharma vol. 2 (via summary)
source_views.view: Only the publisher's summary was available: the antardasha results depend on the sub-lord's strength and position from the lagna and from Rahu, with remedies for adverse periods.

19.14: trouble from the ruler, thieves, poison, fire and weapons, illness of children, mental unrest, loss of relatives, insult from low people, scandal, removal from office, leg injury, failure of ventures. 19.15: with a benefic and outside the 6th, 8th and 12th the period is highly auspicious: near-royal affluence, desires met, domestic comfort, wealth, fame. 19.16: in Virgo, Pisces or Scorpio, honour, land, vehicles and servants, all liable to be lost at the end. 19.21: ill nature or an obscure illness, loss of wife and children, poison, enemies, eye and head ailments, disputes with friends and farmers, the ruler's displeasure.

20.39: Rahu's results follow the planet it is joined with; a benefic joined to Rahu can do harm near the end of its period. 20.52: a node in a kendra or trikona connected with a kendra or trikona lord becomes a yogakaraka. 20.53: a node in a benefic's sign and connected with a planet acts well in that planet's sub-periods. 20.31: Rahu is among the planets whose dasha can prove fatal when it is the weakest of them, timed by Saturn's transit of the 6th, 8th or 12th.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.96, 18.106-109 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, vol. II)
source_views.view: General: loss of comfort, wealth and status, separation from wife, children and kin, severe illness, life abroad, quarrelsomeness. In Cancer, Taurus or Aries: wealth, grain, learning, honour from the ruler. In Virgo, (probably) Gemini or Sagittarius: wife, children, lands, a carriage, liable to be lost at the end. In Leo, Virgo or Cancer (as printed; the list is likely corrupt): kingly status, army command, wealth. Phases: distress at the start, enjoyment in the middle, bereavement of parents and loss of status at the end. OCR verse numbers are irregular.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXIV, pp. 249-251; ch. XXII p. 220
source_views.view: Gives Rahu dasha results sign by sign: good in Aries, Taurus, Cancer, Virgo and Capricorn; bad in Gemini, Leo, Libra, Scorpio (debilitated) and Aquarius; mixed in Sagittarius and Pisces. Results must be adjusted to Rahu's exact position and strength. The nodes give the results of the lords of the houses they occupy (p. 220).

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers, ch. 6 (Planetary Periods), pp. 197-204
source_views.view: Rahu's 18-year period disperses energy and draws attention toward what is foreign or distant; Rahu is separative and can remove one from what it influences. Results follow the houses ruled, occupied and aspected; no special dispositor rule is given.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, 'Rahu is PM Maker', srath.com
source_views.view: Rahu is the key planet for political power. Rahu as or with the Amatyakaraka, or aspecting or joined with the lagna lord, gives political rise in its periods. Rahu in its maranakaraka sthana (the 9th) brings power only after the death, removal or fall of a leader or mentor. Illustrated by Indian prime ministers' charts; anecdotal.
A secondary summary cites Sutton (2001) advising preparation for Rahu's periods and describing the first and last years of the 18 years as the hardest. Her text itself was not read.

disagreements: Signs: Phaladeepika 19.16 counts Scorpio among Rahu's good signs, while Santhanam's BPHS 47 and Raman treat Scorpio as Rahu's debilitation with harmful results. Aquarius is Rahu's own sign in Santhanam's BPHS, yet Raman lists it among the worst placements. Jataka Parijata names Cancer in two different sign groups, and its lists do not match Raman's. Phases: BPHS (afflicted case) gives loss at the start, some relief in the middle and distress at the end; Jataka Parijata gives distress at the start, enjoyment in the middle, and bereavement and loss of status at the end; Phaladeepika 19.16 says gains are lost at the end. Sutton is reported as calling the first and last years the hardest. Lordship: Raman says the nodes give the results of the lord of the house they occupy; Phaladeepika 20.39 stresses the planet joined with Rahu instead; BPHS 47 judges Rahu by its own sign and associations.
phrasing_guidance: Describe Rahu's period as one of ambition, change and unusual opportunities, with the warning that gains can be unstable, and that health, family and dealings with authority need care. Say which conditions in the chart point toward the favourable or the difficult version. Never predict death, poisoning or loss of family members as certain; rephrase maraka lines as a time to take extra care of health. Offer remedies only as traditional practices.

phases: BPHS 47.40-43 (Santhanam), for an afflicted Rahu: wealth is lost at the start, there is some relief and gain in one's own country in the middle, and anxiety and distress come at the end. Jataka Parijata 18.109: distress at the start, considerable enjoyment in the middle, bereavement of parents and loss of status at the end. Phaladeepika 19.16 and Jataka Parijata 18.107: gains made under a well-placed Rahu may be lost when the period ends. BPHS 47.3-4: the period's results are timed by the drekkana Rahu occupies (1st, 2nd or 3rd drekkana gives results at the start, middle or end); Santhanam's note reverses this order for the always-retrograde nodes.
